source_policy: stock Polaris device tree only; no live MMIO or GPU identity read

sources.selected_model: Xiaomi Technologies, Inc. Polaris P2 v2.1
sources.note: All 15 Polaris model DTBs in the chain agree on the GPU/GMU/SMMU/GPUCC nodes; P2 v2.1 is recorded as the representative entry.

gpu.quirks_source: empty (boolean) properties present in the stock DT node
gpu.gmem_source: hakios-xnu-kernel xnu/files/bsd/dev/hakios.adreno.c: the a640 path writes UCHE_GMEM_RANGE_MIN=0x100000 and MAX=0x1fffff, and its GMEM_SIZE query returns 1024*1024 for a640 vs 512*1024 otherwise. That file's a640 branch also loads a630_sqe.fw and a630_zap.mdt, so a640 there denotes the A630/A640-generation part, matching polaris qcom,chipid 0x06030001.

context_banks.sid_source: iommus = <&kgsl_smmu 2>, <&kgsl_smmu 1>; the pair is the DT order, not a sort

smmu.note: This is the GPU's own SMMU instance, distinct from the apps-SMMU that the UFS transport qualifies.

asid_and_context_bank_policy.question: How does SMMU-v2 select a context bank, and is the A642L 'three distinct non-zero ASIDs' policy derivable here?
asid_and_context_bank_policy.answer: A context bank is selected by bank index, not by ASID. No ASID field exists in SMR, S2CR, CBAR, CBA2R or any per-bank register; the A642L policy is a reference-side stage-1 identity plus a pre-map sanity gate, not a device-tree fact.

device_tree_proves.note: Eight context fault lines are a fault-reporting fan-out; the implemented bank count is IDR1[7:0] and is only readable live.

interrupt_decoding.note: #global-interrupts = 2 is the tree's own statement that the first two entries are the global pair.

property_search.method: offline read-only FDT walk; no device, no MMIO

qcom,gpu-offset.reading: recorded, not interpreted; far larger than any bank index and undocumented in the tree

register_layout_evidence.context_block: (pages + bank) * page, pages = 1 << (((IDR1>>28)&7)+1); SCTLR +0x00, ACTLR +0x04, TCR2 +0x10, TTBR0 +0x20, TTBR1 +0x28, TCR +0x30, MAIR0 +0x38, MAIR1 +0x3c, FSR +0x58
register_layout_evidence.selection_path: SID -> SMR slot (VALID + ID match) -> S2CR TYPE=0 -> S2CR CBNDX names the bank -> CBAR/CBA2R/SCTLR configure and enable it

asid_used_by: NativeAdrenoVm.h TLB invalidation prose (unmap synchronizes by ASID; TLBIALL drops the whole bank)
asid_and_context_bank_policy.asid_ttbr0_bit_position: unknown; kits/ArmSmmu4K sources are absent from this checkout (.gitkeep only), so the field position is a live-source question and is not asserted here

reference_policy.gate: gpuAsid, gmuAsid, lpacAsid each non-zero, each <= 0xffff, pairwise distinct
reference_policy.reason: The gate accepts any three distinct non-zero values that fit the ASID width; the device tree supplies stream IDs and interrupt mapping only, and declares no LPAC node or LPAC stream ID.
reference_policy.lpac_sid_note: SID 1 exists here only as the second gfx3d_secure bank; it must not be reused as an LPAC stream ID.

bank_assignment_is_runtime.decided_by: the reference allocator reading IDR0/IDR1 for the implemented bank count and choosing free banks from first-stage-1 onwards
unknown: which banks are free at handoff
whether CBA2R is present on this instance

firmware_regions.a630_firmware_inventory_source: MIUI polaris vendor partition dump; the same bytes also appear under polaris_ios16_flashable_drivers_0115_20261030/drivers/firmware/a630
firmware_regions.a630_firmware_inventory_note: Every A630-named firmware artefact reachable offline on this host, hashed in place. No A660 firmware image exists locally: the only A660 material is reference source code (references/unixnu-adreno6xx/NativeAdrenoA6xxGmu.cpp), so the gap is not 'A660 instead of A630'. Entries sharing a sha256 are byte-identical copies; duplicate_of names the MIUI original. usable_for_polaris is false for every entry because nothing here proves loadability, signature or execution.
